reason: The escrow honestly speaks to me since I've chased a brand for weeks to get paid. But at my size, my deals come from brands that already reach out, and a small pool of small businesses probably can't pay my rates. So I'd be giving up 10% for a marketplace that has nothing in it for me yet.
objection: There aren't enough brands with real budgets yet, and the growth tools sound like the generic hook advice I already get from studying other creators all day.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me run my existing brand deals through the escrow for a smaller cut, or proof that brands on there are booking 100K+ creators at $2K+ per post.
